# Agent adapters: open a terminal running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Qwen Code with graph-manager's tools connected (server)

## What to build

graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager`) can now open a terminal **with a specific agent** in it. `POST /api/terminals` accepts `agent: "claude" | "codex" | "opencode" | "qwen"`; the server checks the agent's CLI is installed, connects graph-manager's MCP server (`graph-manager-mcp`) to it — by injecting flags/env at launch, or, for Qwen Code, by writing and committing `.qwen/settings.json` in the workspace — then spawns the normal shell and types the agent's command line into it. `GET /api/agents` lists the agents and whether each is installed. This slice is server-only; the web buttons come in another slice.

Already in the codebase (read them): `GM_TERMINAL_ID` is set in every terminal's env; `writeMcpShim(binDir, mcpJs)` in `src/server/terminals.ts` writes `<dataDir>/bin/graph-manager-mcp` and `app.ts` puts `binDir` on the terminals' `PATH` when it was written; `src/server/mcp.ts` is the stdio MCP server. The spec is `docs/prd/agent-tools.md` — read "Decisions", "Terminals", "Agent adapters" and "Routes".

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/agent-tools.md` — the contract, including the adapter table.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (lines 7–31 `TerminalInfo`/`CreateTerminal`; 57–77 `Term`; 152–190 `TerminalManager` constructor, `create`, `spawn`; 222–236 `restart`; 320–334 `defaultTitle`/`info`) — where `agent`, `env` and `input` are added.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` (lines 8–46) — `createBody` (strict zod object) and the `POST /api/terminals` handler to extend.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 33–57 `AppContext`; 68–86 `binDir`, terminal manager, ctx; route list ~128–141).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` (`resolveWorkspace`, `Workspace`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/index.ts` (lines 10–48) — `findOnPath(bin, cwd, env, platform, stat)`: copy this logic into graph-manager (do not change the engine package) for `isInstalled`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` — how graph-manager runs git with `execa` (`execa("git", [...], { cwd })`) and turns failures into errors; mirror that style.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.test.ts` (lines 1–40) and `terminals.test.ts` (lines 1–33) — test setup patterns (temp dirs, login cookie, `describe.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (lines 29–45) — creating a real git workspace in tests (`git init -q -b main`, `user.name`, `user.email`, commit).

## Patterns to follow

**Adapters** (`src/server/agents.ts`):
```ts
export const AGENT_IDS = ["claude", "codex", "opencode", "qwen"] as const;
export type AgentId = (typeof AGENT_IDS)[number];
export const MCP_NAME = "graph-manager";
export const MCP_COMMAND = "graph-manager-mcp";

export interface AgentLaunch { argv: string[]; env?: Record<string, string> }
export interface ProjectConfig { file: string /* workspace-relative, "/" separators */; apply(json: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown>; matches(json: Record<string, unknown>): boolean }
export interface AgentAdapter {
  id: AgentId;
  label: string;          // "Claude Code" | "Codex" | "OpenCode" | "Qwen Code"
  binary: string;         // "claude" | "codex" | "opencode" | "qwen"
  connect: "inject" | "project-config";
  launch(o: { dataDir: string }): AgentLaunch;
  projectConfig?: ProjectConfig;
}
```
Launch lines (exactly, from the spec):
- claude: `["claude", "--mcp-config", path.join(dataDir, "agents", "claude-mcp.json"), "--allowedTools", "mcp__graph-manager"]`. `writeClaudeMcpConfig(dataDir)` writes that file at startup (mode 0o644): `{"mcpServers":{"graph-manager":{"type":"stdio","command":"graph-manager-mcp","args":[]}}}`. Call it from `buildApp`.
- codex: `["codex", "-c", 'mcp_servers.graph-manager.command="graph-manager-mcp"']`.
- opencode: `["opencode"]`, env `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT = JSON.stringify({ $schema: "https://opencode.ai/config.json", mcp: { "graph-manager": { type: "local", command: ["graph-manager-mcp"], enabled: true } } })`.
- qwen: `["qwen"]`, `projectConfig.file = ".qwen/settings.json"`, entry `mcpServers["graph-manager"] = { command: "graph-manager-mcp", trust: true }` (other keys and other `mcpServers` entries kept; `matches` = the existing entry deep-equals this one).

GOTCHA: `terminalEnv` in terminals.ts strips variables matching `AGENT_SESSION_ENV` (`/^(CLAUDECODE$|CLAUDE_|CCR_|CODEX_SANDBOX|CODEX_THREAD_ID$|OPENCODE$|OPENCODE_SERVER|QWEN_CODE$)/`) from the **inherited** env. `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` does not match, and the per-terminal env you add is applied after that filtering anyway, so it reaches the shell.

**Shell quoting** — one helper builds the typed command line:
```ts
/** argv as one command line for the terminal's shell. */
export function commandLine(argv: string[], platform = process.platform): string
// POSIX: tokens matching /^[A-Za-z0-9_\/.:=@%+,-]+$/ stay bare, else '…' with ' → '\''
// win32 (PowerShell): '…' with ' doubled, and the line starts with "& " when the first token is quoted.
```
Test: `commandLine(["codex","-c",'mcp_servers.graph-manager.command="graph-manager-mcp"'])` → `codex -c 'mcp_servers.graph-manager.command="graph-manager-mcp"'`.

**Installed check**: `isInstalled(adapter, env = process.env)` → `findOnPath(adapter.binary, process.cwd(), env) !== undefined` with a local copy of the engine's `findOnPath` (put it in `agents.ts` or a small `src/server/path-lookup.ts`, with its doc comment).

**Project config + commit** (`prepareProjectConfig(adapter, ws: Workspace)`):
```ts
export class AgentPrepareError extends Error { constructor(readonly status: number, message: string) { super(message); } }
// returns { changed: false } | { changed: true; commit: string }
```
1. Read `<ws.path>/<file>`: missing → `{}`; not JSON or not an object → `AgentPrepareError(409, ".qwen/settings.json is not valid JSON")`.
2. `matches(json)` → `{ changed: false }`, no write, no git.
3. Refuse with `AgentPrepareError(409, "cannot commit .qwen/settings.json: <reason>")` when: `git status --porcelain -- <file>` prints anything (reason `it has uncommitted changes`); `git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD` / `REBASE_HEAD` / `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD` / `rebase-merge` / `rebase-apply` exists (reason `a merge, rebase or cherry-pick is in progress`); `git symbolic-ref -q HEAD` fails (reason `HEAD is detached`).
4. `mkdir -p` the folder, write `JSON.stringify(apply(json), null, 2) + "\n"`, `git add -- <file>`, `git commit -q -m "chore: connect graph-manager tools for Qwen Code" -- <file>` (message uses `adapter.label`). If the commit fails: restore the previous content (or delete the file when it did not exist), `git reset -q -- <file>`, throw `AgentPrepareError(409, "cannot commit <file>: <last lines of git's stderr>")`.
5. Return `{ changed: true, commit: <git rev-parse HEAD> }`.
GOTCHA: use `git commit … -- <file>` (pathspec) so other staged changes are not committed. Workspaces are real clones; tests create repos with `git init` and set `user.name`/`user.email` locally.

**TerminalManager** additions (`src/server/terminals.ts`):
```ts
// CreateTerminal
agent?: string;                    // shown in TerminalInfo
env?: Record<string, string>;      // added to this terminal's env at spawn and on restart
input?: string;                    // written to the PTY right after spawn, and again after each restart
// TerminalInfo
agent?: string;
```
Store `agent`, `env`, `input` on `Term`; `spawn` merges `{ ...this.env, ...this.opts.extraEnv?.(), ...term.env, GM_TERMINAL_ID: id }`. Write `input` with `proc.write(input)` immediately after spawning (the PTY buffers it until the shell reads). `info()` includes `agent` when set.

**Route** (`src/server/routes/terminals.ts`): add `agent: z.enum(AGENT_IDS).optional()` to the strict `createBody`. With an agent:
- `!isInstalled` → 400 `{ error: "<binary> is not installed" }`.
- `connect === "project-config"` and no workspace → 400 `{ error: "Qwen Code needs a workspace" }` (`<label> needs a workspace`).
- `prepareProjectConfig` → on `AgentPrepareError` reply with its status and `{ error: message }`; no terminal is created.
- launch = `adapter.launch({ dataDir: config.dataDir })`; create the terminal with `{ cwd, workspaceId, agent: adapter.id, env: launch.env, input: commandLine(launch.argv) + "\r", title }`.
- default title when none given: `<label> · <repo>` where repo is the workspace id's last `~` segment (`github~octo~hello` → `Claude Code · hello`); without a workspace, `<label>`.
- reply 201 with the `TerminalInfo` plus `connected: { changed, commit? }` for project-config agents.
Also add `GET /api/agents` → `{ agents: AGENTS.map((a) => ({ id, label, installed: isInstalled(a), connect })) }` (put it in routes/terminals.ts).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agents.ts` + `agents.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `AGENTS`, `commandLine`, `isInstalled`, `writeClaudeMcpConfig`, `prepareProjectConfig`, `AgentPrepareError`.
- **TESTS**: each adapter's `launch()` argv/env exactly as listed; `commandLine` POSIX + win32 cases; `isInstalled` with a temp dir holding an executable `codex` file on a custom `PATH` (true) and an empty PATH (false); `prepareProjectConfig` in a temp git repo: (a) no file → commits only `.qwen/settings.json` with message `chore: connect graph-manager tools for Qwen Code` (check `git show --name-only --format=%s HEAD`), an unrelated uncommitted file stays uncommitted; (b) second call → `{ changed: false }`, no new commit; (c) existing file `{"theme":"x","mcpServers":{"other":{"command":"o"}}}` committed first → keeps `theme` and `other`; (d) uncommitted edit to the file → 409 `cannot commit .qwen/settings.json: it has uncommitted changes`; (e) detached HEAD → 409 with `HEAD is detached`; (f) invalid JSON → 409 `.qwen/settings.json is not valid JSON`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/agents`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (+ `terminals.test.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: `agent`, `env`, `input` as above.
- **TESTS** (skip on win32): `create({ cwd, env: { FOO: "bar" }, input: "echo foo=$FOO\r" })` with the default shell → output contains `foo=bar`; after `kill`+`restart`, the input is typed again (output contains `foo=bar` twice); `info.agent` is reported.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` and `app.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the route changes and `GET /api/agents`; call `writeClaudeMcpConfig(config.dataDir)` in `buildApp`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/agents.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (skip on win32): a temp `fakebin` dir with executable scripts `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, `qwen`, each:
  ```sh
  #!/bin/sh
  { printf '%s\n' "$0" "$@"; printf 'OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT=%s\n' "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT"; printf 'GM_TERMINAL_ID=%s\n' "$GM_TERMINAL_ID"; } > "$FAKE_OUT/$(basename "$0").txt"
  ```
  Use `vi.stubEnv("PATH", fakebin + ":" + process.env.PATH)` and `vi.stubEnv("FAKE_OUT", outDir)` **before** `buildApp` (TerminalManager copies the env in its constructor); `vi.unstubAllEnvs()` in afterEach. Create a git workspace `ws/github/octo/hello`. Then:
  - `GET /api/agents` → four agents, all `installed: true`; with `qwen` removed from fakebin → `installed: false` and `POST /api/terminals { agent: "qwen", workspaceId }` → 400 `qwen is not installed`.
  - `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId, agent: "claude" }` → 201, `agent: "claude"`, `title: "Claude Code · hello"`; poll (up to ~5 s) for `claude.txt`: lines include `--mcp-config`, `<dataDir>/agents/claude-mcp.json`, `--allowedTools`, `mcp__graph-manager`, and `GM_TERMINAL_ID=<id>`; the JSON file's `mcpServers.graph-manager.command` is `graph-manager-mcp`. After the fake exits, `GET /api/terminals` shows that terminal not `exited` (the shell remains).
  - codex → `codex.txt` includes `-c` and `mcp_servers.graph-manager.command="graph-manager-mcp"`.
  - opencode → `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` JSON parses and `.mcp["graph-manager"].command` equals `["graph-manager-mcp"]`.
  - qwen → 201 with `connected.changed: true`; `git log -1 --format=%s` is `chore: connect graph-manager tools for Qwen Code`; a second POST → `connected.changed: false` and no new commit; with an uncommitted edit to `.qwen/settings.json` → 409 and `GET /api/terminals` count unchanged; at the workspaces root (`{ agent: "qwen" }` without workspace) → 400 `Qwen Code needs a workspace`.
  - unknown agent `{ agent: "vim" }` → 400.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/agents` → `{ agents: [{ id, label, installed, connect }] }` for claude, codex, opencode, qwen.
- [ ] `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId, agent }` launches the agent inside the shell with exactly the flags/env in the spec; quitting the agent leaves the shell running.
- [ ] Qwen Code: commits only `.qwen/settings.json` once; idempotent; 409 on a dirty file, mid-merge/rebase or detached HEAD, without creating a terminal.
- [ ] Not installed → 400 `<binary> is not installed`.
- [ ] Plain `POST /api/terminals` without `agent` behaves exactly as before (existing tests pass).
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager`.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/agents src/server/terminals src/server/routes/agents src/server/routes/terminals
npm test -w graph-manager
```
